# Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs)

**Doc ID:** SCC-2026-001
**Use:** Cross-border transfers of personal data from EEA/UK to a third
country lacking an adequacy decision.

This wrapper documents Nzila's adoption of the **EU Commission Standard
Contractual Clauses 2021/914** (Module-appropriate). Do NOT redraft them —
attach them by reference.

## Modules

| Module | When to use |
|--------|------------|
| Module 1 | Controller → Controller |
| Module 2 | Controller → Processor (most common for Nzila) |
| Module 3 | Processor → Processor |
| Module 4 | Processor → Controller |

## Nzila default annexes (attach to each SCC)

### Annex I.A — Parties

- Data exporter: Nzila Ventures (Controller / Processor as applicable)
- Data importer: _Vendor Legal Name_

### Annex I.B — Description of transfer

- Categories of data subjects: per executed [DPA](data-processing-agreement-template.md) §2
- Categories of personal data: per DPA §2
- Sensitive data: per DPA §2 (special-category if applicable)
- Frequency of transfer: continuous / batch as applicable
- Nature of processing: per DPA §2
- Purpose: per DPA §2
- Period of retention: per [retention schedule](../policies/data-retention-schedule.md)

### Annex I.C — Competent supervisory authority

- For EU data subjects: as designated by lead supervisory authority of the data exporter
- For UK data subjects: ICO

### Annex II — Technical and organizational measures

Adopts measures from [DPA Annex II](data-processing-agreement-template.md).

### Annex III — Sub-processors (Module 2 only)

Maintained per executed DPA §4.

## UK addendum

For data exported from the UK, attach the **UK International Data Transfer Addendum** (Version B1.0) to the EU SCCs.

## PIPEDA — Canada outbound

For transfers FROM Canada, the contractual safeguard standard is set by
PIPEDA Principle 4.1.3 (accountability for transferred data). The DPA Annex II
measures satisfy this; SCCs are not strictly required but are strongly
recommended for transfers to jurisdictions without comparable laws.

## Procedure

1. Identify the transfer (use [DPIA](../dpia/template.md) §3 data flow).
2. Confirm no adequacy decision applies.
3. Attach SCC + Annexes I-III to the executed DPA.
4. Record the transfer in vendor register.
5. Re-evaluate annually or on regulatory change (e.g., new adequacy decision).
